'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2022 Kazakh protests]]
**Twenty-six anti-[[government of Kazakhstan|government]] protestors are killed during a military operation in [[Almaty]]. The death toll of security forces increases to 18 with two of the officers being [[Decapitation|beheaded]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-59900037 (BBC News)]
**Explosions and heavy gunfire are reported near the main [[Republic Square, Almaty|Republic Square]] in Almaty. [https://www.independent.co.uk/asia/central-asia/kazakhstan-protests-almaty-news-live-b1987978.html (''The Independent'')]
**The [[Collective Security Treaty Organization]] [[military alliance]] approves what it describes a [[peacekeeping]] mission in [[Kazakhstan]] in response to an official request for military assistance from [[President of Kazakhstan|Kazakh president]] [[Kassym-Jomart Tokayev]]. [https://ca.finance.yahoo.com/news/reports-protesters-kazakhstan-storm-city-100909820.html (Yahoo! Finance Canada)]
**[[Russia]]n-led CSTO forces enter Kazakhstan in order to help the [[government of Kazakhstan|government]] restore control of the country, according to a statement from [[Kremlin]] spokesperson [[Maria Zakharova]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2022/01/06/Moscow-led-alliance-sends-first-troops-to-Kazakhstan-Statement (Al Arabiya)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/jan/06/shots-heard-in-kazakhstan-as-protests-enter-third-day (''The Guardian'')]
*Two journalists are killed and their bodies burned during a gang attack in [[Port-au-Prince]], [[Haiti]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-59910742 (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*A 6.1 magnitude earthquake hits [[Nicaragua]]. [https://apnews.com/article/caribbean-earthquakes-nicaragua-managua-776c6c32a83d8bc44b5e741d01609ea5 (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Hong Kong]]
****[[Travel during the COVID-19 pandemic]]
*****[[Hong Kong]] [[Chief Executive of Hong Kong|chief executive]] [[Carrie Lam]] announces a [[travel ban]] from eight countries with high [[SARS-CoV-2]] [[Omicron variant]] cases from January 8 to January 21. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/1/5/hong-kong-bans-flights-from-8-countries-tightens-covid-curbs (Al Jazeera)]
****High-risk establishments such as [[Bar (establishment)|bar]]s and [[gym]]s will be closed from January 7, while dining in restaurants will be banned after 6 p.m. [https://www.scmp.com/news/hong-kong/health-environment/article/3162190/coronavirus-hong-kongs-fifth-wave-has-already (''South China Morning Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iraq]]
****[[Iraq]] reports its first five cases of the SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant in the northern city of [[Duhok]], in [[Iraqi Kurdistan]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/coronavirus/2022/01/06/Iraq-reports-first-cases-of-omicron-variant (Al Arabiya)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Israel]]
****[[Israel]] reports a record for the second consecutive day of 16,115 new cases of COVID-19. [https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/article-691695 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
****The [[United States Armed Forces]] order all personnel [[United States Forces Japan|stationed]] in [[Japan]] to [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic|wear mask]]s when traveling off-base amid criticism of their handling of the increase in COVID-19 cases in areas where they are based in large numbers, such as [[Okinawa Island|Okinawa]] and [[Iwakuni]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/us-forces-japan-ordered-wear-masks-covid-cases-82105051 (ABC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Malaysia]]
****[[Malaysia]] grants conditional approval for the [[Pfizer-BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine]] to be used in children between the ages of 5 and 11 years. [https://www.nst.com.my/amp/news/nation/2022/01/760847/pfizer-vaccine-children-5-11-gets-conditional-approval (''New Straits Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Pakistan]]
****[[Pakistan]]i [[President of Pakistan|president]] [[Arif Alvi]] tests positive for COVID-19 for the second time. [https://www.brecorder.com/news/40145233/president-dr-arif-alvi-tests-positive-for-covid-19 (''Business Recorder'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Thailand]]
****[[Thailand]] raises its [[COVID-19]] Alert level to level four following a rapid increase in cases caused by the SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant. [https://www.bangkokpost.com/thailand/general/2243059/covid-alert-level-increased-as-new-cases-rise (''Bangkok Post'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****[[Italy]] reports a record for the third consecutive day of 219,441 new cases of COVID-19, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 6.97 million. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/latest-on-coronavirus-outbreak/italy-records-its-highest-daily-spike-in-covid-cases/2467528 (Anadolu Agency)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey]]
****[[Turkey]] reports a record for the second consecutive day of 68,413 new cases of COVID-19. [https://english.aawsat.com/home/article/3399526/turkey-logs-record-daily-covid-19-cases-amid-omicron-surge (''Asharq Al-Awsat'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ukraine]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Ukraine]]
****[[Ukraine]] begins administering [[booster shot]]s of the COVID-19 vaccine for all adults who received their second dose at least six months prior. [https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-society/3381042-booster-shot-for-covid19-now-available-to-all-adult-ukrainians-six-months-after-last-jab-health-minister.html (Ukrinform)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina]]
****[[Argentina]] surpasses 6 million cases of COVID-19 after reporting a record for the third consecutive day of 109,608 new cases of COVID-19. [https://www3.nhk.or.jp/nhkworld/en/news/20220107_09/ (NHK World-Japan)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Peru]]
****[[Peru]] raises its pandemic Alert level in 24 [[Provinces of Peru|provinces]] from "moderate" to "high", resulting in an extended curfew between 11 p.m. and 5 a.m., as well as tightened capacity limits in shopping centers, banks and restaurants. This comes as the number of daily COVID-19 cases increased 25% from the previous week. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/peru-raises-covid-19-alert-tightens-curbs-amid-omicron-wave-2022-01-06/ (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Northern Territory]]
****The [[Northern Territory]] imposes a [[COVID-19 lockdowns|lockdown]] until Monday for people over the age of 16 years who are unvaccinated against COVID-19 after the territory reported a record 256 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2022-01-06/nt-covid-numbers-michael-gunner/100741026 (ABC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Victoria]]
****Density limits are reintroduced to hospitality and entertainment venues and non-urgent elective surgeries are paused as cases and hospitalisations rise in the state. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/jan/07/victoria-and-nsw-covid-restrictions-explained-new-limits-for-hospitality-testing-changes-and-elective-surgery-pause (''The Guardian'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Illinois]], [[Strikes during the COVID-19 pandemic]]
****The [[Chicago Public Schools]] announces that schools in [[Chicago]], [[Illinois]], has been canceled for a third consecutive day as teachers in the city go on a strike over COVID-19 protocols. [https://www.nationalreview.com/news/chicago-public-schools-cancel-classes-for-third-day-as-teachers-strike/ (''National Review'')] [https://www.chicagotribune.com/news/breaking/ct-chicago-public-schools-covid-teachers-union-20220106-7fttwx7zbzb2hfvsaefg2nxn7m-story.html (''Chicago Tribune'')]
*[[2020–2022 H5N8 outbreak]]
**A 79-year-old man in [[Buckfastleigh]], [[Devon]], becomes the first person in the [[United Kingdom]] to test positive for [[Avian influenza|bird flu]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/jan/07/first-uk-person-to-catch-h5n1-bird-flu-strain-is-named (''The Guardian'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]], [[Vaccine passports during the COVID-19 pandemic]]
**The [[France|French]] [[National Assembly (France)|National Assembly]] votes 214−93 with 27 abstentions to approve a bill to transform the COVID-19 health pass into a vaccine pass, which would require people over the age of 12 years to show proof of [[COVID-19 vaccination in France|vaccination]] in order to enter most public places and use inter-regional [[public transport]]. The bill will be debated in the [[Senate (France)|Senate]] early next week and is expected to come into effect later this month. [https://www.euronews.com/2022/01/06/french-mps-approve-vaccine-pass-law-after-initial-government-rebuke (Euronews)]
*[[Philippines|Philippine]] [[President of the Philippines|president]] [[Rodrigo Duterte]] signs into law a bill outlawing [[child marriage]], with violators facing up to 12 months in prison. Some portions of the law will not go into effect for one year in order to allow [[Islam in the Philippines|Muslim]] and [[Indigenous peoples of the Philippines|indigenous]] communities to prepare. [https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/southeast-asia/article/3162418/philippines-bans-child-marriage-it-debases-degrades-and (''South China Morning Post'')] 
*[[President of the United States|United States President]] [[Joe Biden]] blames former President [[Donald Trump]] squarely over his role in the [[January 6 United States Capitol attack]]. [https://www.cnn.com/politics/live-news/january-6-capitol-insurrection-anniversary/index.html (CNN)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2022 Australian Open]], [[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports]]
**[[2021 Australian Open – Men's Singles|2021 Men's Singles champion]] [[Novak Djokovic]] is detained by the [[Australian Border Force]] for failing to provide a valid medical exemption to explain his not being [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccinated]] against [[COVID-19]] under federal guidelines. The [[Victoria State Government]] and [[Tennis Australia]] had previously approved Djokovic's exemption under their own guidelines, which was not endorsed by the federal [[Australian Technical Advisory Group on Immunisation|Technical Advisory Group on Immunisation]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2022/jan/06/novak-djokovic-visa-cancelled-why-is-the-tennis-star-being-kicked-out-of-australia (''The Guardian'')]
